from copy import deepcopy
from datetime import date
import hashlib
import hmac
import json

import pytest

from trialops.privacy import export_subjects


ON = date(2024, 6, 15)


def make_subject(subject_id="subject-one", **changes):
    record = {
        "id": subject_id,
        "name": "Fictional Person",
        "birth_date": "1990-04-03",
        "email": "person@example.test",
        "country": "NZ",
        "visits": ["2024-05-01", "2024-01-02"],
        "consents": [{"purpose": "research", "signed_on": "2024-06-15"}],
        "purge_after": "2024-06-15",
    }
    record.update(changes)
    return record


def pseudonym(subject_id, *, purpose="research", secret="test-secret"):
    message = f"{purpose}:{subject_id}".encode("utf-8")
    return hmac.new(secret.encode("utf-8"), message, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()[:16]


def canonical(value):
    return json.dumps(
        value,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
        ensure_ascii=False,
        allow_nan=False,
    )

    subjects = [make_subject("subject-b"), make_subject("subject-a")]
    original = deepcopy(subjects)

    expected_rows = [

            "country": "NZ",

            "visits": ["2024-01-02", "2024-05-01"],

            "pseudonym": pseudonym("subject-b"),

    assert subjects == original

def test_output_is_deterministic_and_scoped_to_purpose_and_secret():
    subjects = [make_subject(f"subject-{index}") for index in range(5)]
    for subject in subjects:
        subject["consents"].append({"purpose": "audit", "signed_on": "2024-01-01"})

    first = export_subjects(subjects, purpose="research", secret=SECRET, on=ON)
    second = export_subjects(
        list(reversed(deepcopy(subjects))), purpose="research", secret=SECRET, on=ON
    )
    assert first == second
    assert canonical(first) == canonical(second)
    assert [row["pseudonym"] for row in first["rows"]] == sorted(
        row["pseudonym"] for row in first["rows"]
    )

    other_purpose = export_subjects(subjects, purpose="audit", secret=SECRET, on=ON)
    other_secret = export_subjects(
        subjects, purpose="research", secret="another-secret", on=ON
    )
    pseudonyms = {row["pseudonym"] for row in first["rows"]}
    assert pseudonyms.isdisjoint(row["pseudonym"] for row in other_purpose["rows"])
    assert pseudonyms.isdisjoint(row["pseudonym"] for row in other_secret["rows"])
    assert {row["pseudonym"] for row in other_purpose["rows"]} == {
        pseudonym(f"subject-{index}", purpose="audit") for index in range(5)
    }

# --- execute_reuse_export: integration with the governance workflow ---------


class CountingSubjects:
    """An iterable that records how many times it has been consumed."""

    def __init__(self, records):
        self.records = records
        self.iterations = 0

    def __iter__(self):
        self.iterations += 1
        return iter(self.records)


def make_request(status="approved", **changes):
    purpose = changes.get("purpose", "research")
    value = {
        "id": "reuse-001",
        "requester": "alice",
        "reviewer": "bob",
        "purpose": purpose,
        "status": status,
        "retention_until": "2024-12-31",
        "approval_expires_on": "2024-06-30",
        "privacy_plan": {
            "algorithm": "hmac-sha256",
            "domain": purpose,
            "fields": ["pseudonym", "country", "birth_year", "visits"],
        },
        "metadata": {
            "representative": True,
            "complete": True,
            "quality_score": 0.99,
        },
        "history": [],
    }
    value.update(changes)
    return value


def exception_chain_messages(error):
    messages = []
    while error is not None:
        messages.append(str(error))
        error = error.__cause__ or error.__context__
    return messages


def test_reuse_export_end_to_end_through_the_governance_workflow():
    draft = make_request("draft")
    del draft["approval_expires_on"]
    submitted = apply_reuse_action(draft, "submit", "alice", NOW - timedelta(days=2))
    approved = apply_reuse_action(submitted, "approve", "bob", NOW - timedelta(days=1))
    approved_snapshot = deepcopy(approved)

    withdrawn = make_subject("withdrawn")
    withdrawn["consents"][0]["withdrawn_on"] = "2024-06-15"
    records = [
        make_subject("sensitive-id"),
        make_subject("subject-a"),
        withdrawn,
        make_subject("expired", purge_after="2024-06-14"),
    ]
    records_snapshot = deepcopy(records)
    subjects = CountingSubjects(records)

    executed = execute_reuse_export(
        approved, subjects, actor="alice", secret=SECRET, now=NOW
    )

    expected_export = export_subjects(
        records_snapshot, purpose="research", secret=SECRET, on=ON
    )
    assert expected_export["manifest"]["count"] == 2
    assert executed["execution_result"] == expected_export
    assert [row["pseudonym"] for row in executed["execution_result"]["rows"]] == sorted(
        [pseudonym("sensitive-id"), pseudonym("subject-a")]
    )
    assert executed == {
        **approved_snapshot,
        "status": "executed",
        "execution_result": expected_export,
        "history": approved_snapshot["history"]
        + [{"action": "execute", "actor": "alice", "at": "2024-06-15T12:00:00Z"}],
    }
    assert [entry["action"] for entry in executed["history"]] == [
        "submit",
        "approve",
        "execute",
    ]

    assert subjects.iterations == 1
    assert records == records_snapshot
    assert approved == approved_snapshot
    assert executed is not approved
    assert executed["history"] is not approved["history"]

    for text in (canonical(executed), repr(executed)):
        for identifier in DIRECT_IDENTIFIERS:
            assert identifier not in text


def test_reuse_export_delegates_once_to_governance_and_once_to_export(monkeypatch):
    apply_calls = []
    export_calls = []
    real_apply = privacy.apply_reuse_action
    real_export = privacy.export_subjects

    def counting_apply(*args, **kwargs):
        apply_calls.append((args, kwargs))
        return real_apply(*args, **kwargs)

    def counting_export(*args, **kwargs):
        export_calls.append((args, kwargs))
        return real_export(*args, **kwargs)

    monkeypatch.setattr(privacy, "apply_reuse_action", counting_apply)
    monkeypatch.setattr(privacy, "export_subjects", counting_export)

    approved = make_request(purpose="methods research")
    subjects = [make_subject()]
    subjects[0]["consents"][0]["purpose"] = "methods research"

    executed = privacy.execute_reuse_export(
        approved, subjects, actor="alice", secret=SECRET, now=NOW
    )

    assert len(apply_calls) == 1
    args, kwargs = apply_calls[0]
    assert args == (approved, "execute", "alice", NOW)
    assert args[0] is approved
    assert set(kwargs) == {"executor"}
    assert callable(kwargs["executor"])

    assert len(export_calls) == 1
    export_args, export_kwargs = export_calls[0]
    assert len(export_args) == 1 and export_args[0] is subjects
    assert export_kwargs == {"purpose": "methods research", "secret": SECRET, "on": ON}

    assert executed["execution_result"]["rows"][0]["pseudonym"] == pseudonym(
        "subject-one", purpose="methods research"
    )

def test_export_failures_roll_back_to_the_unchanged_approved_request(
